stock.description: As an investment holding company, FIH Mobile Limited delivers comprehensive manufacturing solutions to the global mobile phone industry. Its extensive operations are geographically segmented across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The enterprise is involved in the design, production, distribution, and trading of mobile communication devices, in addition to offering essential repair services. Significant resources are also dedicated to research and development activities. Established in 2000 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, the company adopted its current name, FIH Mobile Limited, in May 2013, having previously been known as Foxconn International Holdings Limited. It operates as a subsidiary of Foxconn (Far East) Limited.
